title: Reply result
description: Body of POST /v1/replies/{reply_id}/result: what the Companion made of reply.execute (docs/TZ.md §5.6, §7.4). Only the Companion whose event the reply answers sends it, with its device token. The relay answers 204, 404 not_found for a reply_id it does not know for this Companion and 409 duplicate once the reply has a result.

status.description: sent once actionIntent.send() went through; failed when the reply could not be sent.

error.description: Why a failed reply was not sent: notification_gone when the notification is no longer in the shade or the listener is not connected, remote_input_unsupported when no action takes free text.
